item.title: S Subramanyeswar Set To Join Omnicom Advertising India As Chief Strategy Officer
item.description: S. Subramanyeswar, Asia–Pacific CSO at MullenLowe Global, will lead strategy in India amid Omnicom–IPG merger.

item.title: Josy Paul Continues As BBDO India Chief Post Omnicom–IPG Merger
item.description: BBDO India affirms Josy Paul’s creative leadership continuity even after the Omnicom–IPG Mediabrands consolidation.

item.title: Charlie Smith Joins Nothing As Chief Brand Officer
item.description: Former Loewe marketing head Charlie Smith has taken on the global brand and marketing mandate at Nothing, reporting to co-founder and CEO Carl Pei.

item.title: Reliance Completes Merger Of Star Television Productions With JioStar
item.description: Reliance confirms that Star Television Productions has been fully merged into JioStar, completing the approved scheme of arrangement.

item.title: India D2C Brands See 58% Gross Merchandise Volume Jump Over Black Friday–Cyber Monday Weekend: GoKwik
item.description: After leading a nationwide retail shift, Bharat has seen a significant rise in online shopping during the Black Friday & Cyber Monday weekend, with D2C brands on GoKwik’s network reporting a 58% year-on-year jump in Gross Merchandise Volume and a 63% increase in total orders.

item.title: Chandni Shah Takes Charge As CEO Of Kinnect–22feet Tribal
item.description: Chandni Shah steps up as CEO, Rohan Mehta elevated to lead digital integration across Omnicom Advertising India, as shared with Marketing Mind by someone from the company.

item.title: Maliao Cosmetics Launches Campaign Highlighting Versatile Beauty For Every Look
item.description: Maliao Cosmetics has unveiled its “Glow-Off” campaign to highlight duality in beauty and reflect the many identities embraced by young Indian consumers.

item.title: Sanjay Nandan Appoints As Creative Head At Laqshya StoryWorks
item.description: With over 25 years of experience in storytelling, editing, and production, Sanjay Nandan has joined Laqshya StoryWorks as Creative Head, leading the content studio’s creative output across fiction, non-fiction, and AI-enabled projects.

item.title: India’s Gen Z Cohort Will Be A $2 Trillion Economy By 2035: Snap’s Ankit Goyle
item.description: In conversation with Marketing Mind, Ankit Goyle, Head of Marketing – India at Snap Inc., opens up about the making of ‘Say It In A Snap’, the rise of camera-led storytelling, the $2 trillion Gen Z economy, and why brands must rethink how they show up.

item.title: Kartik Sharma Takes Charge As CEO, Amardeep Singh As COO, Shashi Sinha As Strategic Advisor At Omnicom Media India
item.description: Kartik Sharma, Amardeep Singh and Shashi Sinha step into key leadership roles as Omnicom Media strengthens its India structure amid the Omnicom–IPG Mediabrands merger.
